text:
Type: tall glass display cabinet
Use: displaying glassware, china, books and collectibles; dining room, living room
Style: traditional, classic, contemporary
Materials: black-stained wood veneer with visible grain, clear glass door and side panels, glass shelves, brass-tone knob
Colors: deep black, clear glass, small gold knob
Shape: tall narrow cabinet with one glass door and glass sides, lower closed panel section, crown molding top, molded plinth base, glass shelves, stately and slim, medium visual weight
Feel: elegant, dramatic, refined, formal
Goes with: white or grey walls, brass accents, dark wood, crystal; classic or traditional dining rooms and living rooms

product.name: MALSJ
product.description: Glass doors keep your favourite items free from dust but still visible.
